name: CraftBench
intro: CraftBench 不是独立评测集，而是 Agent World Model（AWM）论文附录表 16 列出的一个合成环境场景，完整名称为 Custom Manufacturing Job Tracker。公开资料只披露该场景名称；构建与训练沿用 AWM 的通用环境合成、任务生成和数据库验证流程。
build_method: AWM 从场景名称扩展、CRUD 过滤与嵌入去重开始，再生成任务、SQLite 状态、MCP 工具和验证代码；CraftBench 只是其中一个命名场景
metric: 无独立指标（AWM 训练奖励）
eval_feature: SQL 状态变化验证与代码增强 LLM 判分；不是 CraftBench 专属评测
scale: AWM 共 1,000 个环境、10,000 个任务；CraftBench 仅为 1 个场景名称
build_method_en: AWM expands scenario names, applies CRUD filtering and embedding deduplication, then synthesizes tasks, SQLite state, MCP tools and verification code; CraftBench is only one named scenario
eval_feature_en: SQL state-difference verification and code-augmented LLM judging; not a CraftBench-specific evaluation
intro_en: CraftBench is not a standalone evaluation set. It is one synthetic environment scenario listed in Agent World Model Appendix Table 16, with the full name Custom Manufacturing Job Tracker. Public sources disclose only the scenario name; its construction and training follow the AWM-wide environment, task and database-verification pipeline.
scale_en: AWM has 1,000 environments and 10,000 tasks; CraftBench is one scenario name
flowchart_en: 100 domain seeds → scenario expansion/CRUD filter/dedup → 1,000 AWM scenarios including the CraftBench name → identity boundary → AWM-wide task, SQLite, MCP, verifier and reward pipeline.
flowchart_zh: 100 个域名种子 → 场景扩展、CRUD 过滤与去重 → 含 CraftBench 名称的 1,000 个 AWM 场景 → 身份边界 → AWM 通用任务、SQLite、MCP、验证器与奖励流程。
drawio_review_note: Aligned with Agent World Model arXiv:2602.10090 Sections 3-4, Appendix A and Table 16 plus the official Snowflake-Labs repository. CraftBench is only the Custom Manufacturing Job Tracker scenario name inside AWM's 1,000-environment collection, not an independently specified benchmark. The diagram therefore shows the AWM-wide scenario, task, SQLite, MCP, verifier, self-correction and reward pipeline while explicitly preserving the missing CraftBench-specific item count, split, prompt, evaluation run and metric.
